name: Brann Bronzebeard
summary: Brann Bronzebeard is the youngest brother of King Magni and Muradin, who is believed dead, renowned throughout Azeroth as a peerless explorer, archaeologist, and founding leader of the Explorers' League. Driven by an insatiable curiosity for titan ruins and ancient history, his wanderlust has led him deep into the deadly wastes of Silithus. His field companions in southern Silithus await news of his latest expedition.

sections.title: A Royal Wanderer
sections.body: While his eldest brother Magni rules Ironforge from the throne and Muradin served on battlefield frontlines, Brann took to the open wilds. He was a veteran warrior of the Second War, fighting in the Siege of Ironforge and following High General Anduin Lothar and Turalyon all the way to the Dark Portal's destruction. Yet peacetime turned his formidable constitution toward uncovering the forgotten past. As a leader of the Explorers' League, Brann charted vast swathes of the Eastern Kingdoms—from Elwynn Forest to the untamed jungles of Zul'Gurub—before turning his gaze across the Great Sea to the mysteries of ancient Kalimdor.

sections.title: Trouble in Silithus
sections.body: Drawn south by reports from the Cenarion Circle concerning the Old God C'Thun and the slumbering qiraji swarm, Brann established the Bronzebeard Encampment in southern Silithus alongside fellow explorers Rutgar Glyphshaper and Frankal Stonebridge. Tragedy struck when the priestess Natalia Mar'alith, maddened by the whispering horrors of the shifting sands, raided their camp. When Brann refused her demand to lead them back into Hive'Regal, she went mad and attacked, and Brann, his crew, and his pet ape Glibb only barely fought her off.

sections.title: Beyond the Scarab Wall
sections.body: Rather than retreating after the terrifying assault, the intrepid archaeologist became obsessed with entering the sealed kingdom behind the Scarab Wall. Brann discovered a hidden subterranean tunnel that bypassed the ancient barrier entirely and ventured inside alone, leaving Glibb in the care of his expedition with strict written orders to provide the ape with plenty of food, water, and affectionate hugs. His companions remain stranded in southern Silithus, desperately awaiting word from within the silithid hives.

faq.answer: He is the youngest brother of King Magni Bronzebeard of Ironforge and a co-founder and driving force behind the dwarven Explorers' League. Rather than sitting in council chambers, Brann is a legendary archaeologist and cartographer who travels Azeroth's most dangerous frontiers to uncover titan artifacts and lost civilizations.

faq.q: Where is Brann Bronzebeard right now?
faq.answer: His trail leads to Silithus, where Rutgar Glyphshaper and Frankal Stonebridge maintain the Bronzebeard Encampment. They may have information about his latest expedition.

faq.q: What happened to his camp in Silithus?
faq.answer: Rutgar Glyphshaper and Frankal Stonebridge have troubling news about the expedition. Speaking with them reveals what happened at the camp.
Glibb is Brann Bronzebeard's companion ape, staying with the explorers at Bronzebeard Encampment in Silithus.

faq.q: Did Brann fight in the Second War?
aliases: was brann in the alliance army
faq.answer: Yes. Brann fought in the Siege of Ironforge before marching alongside his brother Muradin under Anduin Lothar and Turalyon to Blackrock Mountain, fighting forest trolls and orcs all the way to the Dark Portal.

faq.q: Why is Brann interested in Silithus?
aliases: why did brann go to silithus
faq.answer: Brann was drawn to the desert by Cenarion Circle whispers concerning the Old God C'Thun, titan history, and the trapped qiraji empire, prompting him to find a way beyond the sealed Scarab Wall to inspect the ruins first-hand.

angles.text: As the youngest brother of King Magni, Brann embodies the dwarven passion for digging into the roots of their titan heritage.
Brann's expeditionary work directly fuels the knowledge and archives of the Alliance, though his habit of vanishing without a trace often drives Ironforge's leadership to distraction.
